Thank you for reaching out.
Following your request and after our review, we can confirm that the charge season you mentioned, which was supposed to begin on 08/11/2025 and end on 12/11/2025, does not exist.
However, in DC2, we can see another charge season, as shown in the screenshot below, and all charge seasons have been processed correctly without any issues.
Should you require any additional information or assistance in the meantime, please do not hesitate to contact us.
Kind regards,
Anass Mezzaoui

additional_info.subject: Webform_incident_SiCharge D_23-01-2026_SN: NBUVTu CRM:03275000105
additional_info.body:
Dear BASTIEN BONHOMME,
Following your request and after completing our checks, we can confirm that the EV is requesting 9.4A, which caused the last transaction, as shown in the screenshot below.
Please note that the charger only provides the current requested by the vehicle. In this case, the charger is operating normally and is in good health. There are no issues related to the charger.
Should you require any additional information or assistance in the meantime, please do not hesitate to contact us.
Kind regards,
Anass Mezzaoui
eMobility Technical Support Team
